basic_info.description: On one of Noe's most coveted flat blocks, blending Victorian charm w/ stunning southern views. Likely built by famed Noe architect John Anderson, this home boasts undeniable curb appeal, custom paint, period details & a blooming saucer magnolia. Inside, high ceilings, refinished wood floors & a grand staircase set the tone. The sunlit living rm flows into a dining rm w/ bay window & views beyond. A brand-new chef's kitchen features Thermador appliances, quartz counters & honed quartz sink, opening to a sun-drenched family rm framed by sweeping views from Bernal to Diamond Hts. Step onto the lg deck, overlooking a generous backyard w/ endless potential. Thoughtfully updated w/ all new electrical, and a host of other updates. Upstairs, 3 spacious BRs incl. a primary suite w/ spacious closets. Downstairs: flex space ideal in-law, fam rm, or office w/ kitchenette & bath. Laundry/gym & EV-ready garage. A true sanctuary in Noe Valley, SF's sunniest & most charming neighborhood!
